title: Law to add DRIE training and disability office to rent freeze outreach
summary: This bill expands existing rent freeze information requirements to include the Disability Rent Increase Exemption program alongside the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption program, and adds the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities as a participating agency. It requires the Department of Finance to provide annual training on eligibility, applications, accommodations and referrals to designated staff at participating agencies starting by June 30, 2027, and to report annually to the Council on such trainings by October 1, 2027.
